reasons: Cited Section 13 (p0078) is accurately characterized: automatic renewal for successive one-year (not multi-year) periods with either party able to block renewal on 30 days' written notice, which satisfies the preferred position on renewal term length and opt-out window and is far inside the walk-away thresholds.

The two absent preferred sub-elements (60-day vendor reminder; CPI/3% uplift cap) are correctly noted in the rationale rather than redlined, consistent with the playbook's treatment of minor sub-elements; the Section 6 (p0047) one-year price freeze and most-favoured-rate commitment are described accurately.
No redline or comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs.

The failed deterministic check ('number not found') is a parsing artifact — the clause plainly states 'thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year', which is within the ≤60-day requirement — so it does not undermine the substance.
